plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: brand lockup opens, bottle sits beside the big 30% OFF text block, then the SUMMER ONLY badge and legal stacked in a narrow column just before a generous CTA anchored at the right.

Product-led: the bottle opens the strip at the left edge, the offer text dominates the middle, and a right-hand brand-and-action cluster has the logo stacked above the CTA, with the badge and legal grouped between text and action.
Headline-first: 30% OFF opens at the left as the clear focal point, then the bottle with its SUMMER ONLY badge, then the CTA, and the brand logo signs off at the far right above the fine print.
